findings.location: Summary, second paragraph: the dual-surgery sentence and the swap-framing sentence.
findings.evidence: The inverse of p-surgery on S^p times S^q is a (q−1)-surgery returning S^p times S^q. The displayed p-surgery on the sphere producing S^(p+1) times S^(q−1) is a separate operation. Also, swapping meridian and longitude does not extend over the removed solid torus and is not a framing change. The repaired assigned examples establish the correct inverse and use actual zero- and one-twist framing embeddings. B-page prose remains outside this reader's edit authority.

findings.location: Definition, original face paragraph: “they are the two connected components”.
findings.evidence: A decomposition of the boundary into incoming and outgoing faces does not make each face a connected component. Faces can be disconnected or empty; a pair-of-pants bordism has three boundary components. Another writer subsequently corrected this batch-1 supplier. This finding records the historical observation; the original raw bytes were not fingerprinted, and corrected current bytes are not bound as the defective observation.
